messages.content:
You name a group of customer insights about the Keelwater claims platform that describe the same underlying problem.

Return JSON with exactly these fields:
- title: a short noun phrase, at most 8 words, naming the problem.
- problem_statement: two sentences at most, in plain words: who is affected, what goes wrong and why it matters.

Use only the problems and quotes given. Name no customer or person. Do not mention ARR or counts.

- problem: The system does not provide live updates from garages, causing daily frustration for the team.
  quote: daily frustrations with the system’s lack of live updates from garages
- problem: The platform lacks live repair updates, forcing users to manually call garages for status checks.
  quote: we can’t see live repair updates — it’s a daily grind. We’re spending too much time calling garages because we can’t see live repair updates
- problem: The platform lacks automated claim progress messaging, forcing users to manually draft and send updates which is inefficient and error-prone.
  quote: we’re manually sending claim progress messages, but it’s time-consuming and inconsistent. Right now we’re manually drafting and sending claim progress messages to keep policyholders informed, but it’s inefficient and error-prone.
- problem: The platform lacks an automated way to send status updates to policyholders during the claims process.
  quote: Is there a way to automate those messages?
- problem: The current process for tracking garage progress requires manual calls to suppliers, which disrupts the workflow and takes time away from core claims tasks.
  quote: We’re still wrestling with how to track garage progress visibility without calling every supplier manually — it really breaks up our day and distracts from core claims work.
- problem: The system lacks built-in visibility into garage progress, forcing users to interrupt their work with phone calls.
  quote: we need garage progress visibility baked into the system so we don’t have to interrupt our daily work with phone calls
- problem: The system does not display live repair progress, forcing handlers to manually call garages for updates.
  quote: our handlers are spending half their day calling garages because we can’t see live repair progress in the system.
- problem: The current workflow or missing features are causing inefficiency and consuming time that should be spent on core tasks.
  quote: it’s not just annoying, it’s eating into time we could spend on policyholders or tasks.
